_comment: Hand-curated top Kochi sights for the day planner. Hours, closed days, dwell (minutes) and popularity (0-1) are APPROXIMATE, gathered from common visitor guidance; coordinates are approximate. Verify before relying on them. Hours are IST 'HH:MM' windows; closedDays uses 0 = Sunday.
verify: Check each venue's current timings (ASI / Kerala Tourism / venue notice boards); festival days and Jewish holidays change hours.

sights.name: Chinese Fishing Nets
sights.address: Fort Kochi beach road, Fort Kochi
sights.blurb: Iconic cantilevered nets on the Fort Kochi shore; best in the morning catch or at sunset.

sights.name: Fort Kochi Beach
sights.blurb: Breezy promenade with ships passing into the harbour; a classic sunset spot.

sights.name: St. Francis Church
sights.blurb: One of India's oldest European churches; Vasco da Gama was first buried here.

sights.name: Santa Cruz Cathedral Basilica
sights.address: K B Jacob Road, Fort Kochi
sights.blurb: Gothic-style basilica with painted ceilings and stained glass.

sights.name: Indo-Portuguese Museum
sights.blurb: Church art and silverware from the Portuguese era in Kochi.

sights.name: Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace)
sights.blurb: Portuguese-built palace of the Kochi rajas, famous for its Ramayana murals.

sights.name: Paradesi Synagogue
sights.blurb: 16th-century synagogue with hand-painted Chinese floor tiles and Belgian chandeliers.

sights.name: Jew Town Spice & Antique Market
sights.blurb: Lanes of spice warehouses, antique shops and cafés next to the synagogue.

sights.name: Dutch Cemetery
sights.blurb: Weathered 18th-century Dutch tombs, usually seen through the gate.

sights.name: Kerala Folklore Museum
sights.blurb: Three floors of masks, costumes and carvings in a building made from old temple parts.

sights.name: Marine Drive Walkway
sights.blurb: Backwater promenade with the Rainbow Bridge; lively in the evening.

sights.name: Ernakulathappan (Shiva) Temple
sights.blurb: The city's namesake temple; traditional dress code applies inside.

sights.name: Hill Palace Museum
sights.blurb: Former Kochi royal palace, now Kerala's largest archaeological museum, set in a deer park.

sights.name: Mangalavanam Bird Sanctuary
sights.blurb: Small mangrove pocket in the city, good for egrets and cormorants early in the day.

sights.name: Cherai Beach
sights.blurb: Long sandy beach with the backwaters just behind it.

sights.name: Lulu Mall
sights.blurb: One of India's largest malls, with an ice rink and arcade.
